_howto: Suggested counters for a boss's collection page. Key each boss by its page name (collections/<slug>.html, e.g. mega-gardevoir). 'counters' are attackers, 'catchTanks' catch tanks; each needs a name, and can have fm (fast move), cm (charge move - two as "A, B") and a note shown on hover. They fill in when the archive has fewer than 6 attackers or 4 catch tanks; add "always": true to show them even when it has more. Pokemon and move names as on the site, e.g. "Shadow Mewtwo", "Psycho Cut".
